dog.description_text: Pietro was found as a stray and is still learning that the world can be a safe place. He can be a little shy when meeting new people, but with patience, kindness, and a little time, his sweet personality begins to shine through. Pietro is looking for a loving home where he can build confidence at his own pace and finally enjoy the security he deserves.
dog.name: Pietro
